answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Re-attestations are stored in jade and prism lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1666 impostors cost 927 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
